fusions.name: Thousand-Hoof Thunder
fusions.desc: Stampedes through a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 34 damage to everything in it and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Drumming Heels
fusions.desc: A heel strike that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 8% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Full Tilt
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds, with +5% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Ground-Eating Stride
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
